title: Surprise Democratic Donor Blitzes Senate Races in Republican-Leaning States With Ads
summary: Steve Pajcic, a lawyer and philanthropist in Florida, started a group that is airing ads in Kansas and South Carolina. Florida and Mississippi are next.
